controls.label: Spread angle
controls.serializedMeaning: Total angular span between the first and last mounted ordered card before derived canvas recomposition.
controls.causalObservation: Changes every non-central slot angle and the projected fan width while preserving hinge and order.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines Open Fan's primary silhouette; not a shared Frame, Look, or Timeline property.

controls.label: Hinge height
controls.serializedMeaning: Common bottom-centre hinge y-coordinate as a percentage of stage height before safe-area clamping.
controls.causalObservation: Moves every card bottom-centre together without changing spread, ratio, or source order.
controls.ownershipReason: The shared hinge is the Scene's physical cause.

controls.label: Card size
controls.serializedMeaning: Unpadded card width as a percentage of the stage short axis before source-ratio height resolution.
controls.causalObservation: Changes card projected bounds and derived collision compression; does not alter source fit.
controls.ownershipReason: Controls the collection-versus-object reading of the fan.

controls.label: Featured lift
controls.serializedMeaning: Maximum radial translation of spotlight/finale card from its stable angular slot.
controls.causalObservation: Changes selected-card radial displacement only; zero-time and return poses remain unchanged.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines authored lift while avoiding generic zoom.

controls.label: Paper breath
controls.serializedMeaning: Maximum deterministic settled micro-translation; forced to zero in reduced motion and at phase seams.
controls.causalObservation: Changes sub-pixel settled y displacement without changing angle, order, or hold fidelity.
controls.ownershipReason: Optional material micro-motion belongs to this Scene; it remains bounded and causal.
